react.description: Checkboxes allow the user to select one or more items from a set.

tags.devx:
- Supports controlled (`checked`) and uncontrolled (`defaultChecked`) modes.
- Handles `indeterminate` state strictly as visual (updates UI, but underlying input is checked/unchecked based on logic).
tags.a11y:
- Uses native input for accessibility.
- Supports standard keyboard interaction.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

id.name: id
id.description: Id of the underlying form control. Auto-generated if not provided.

checked.name: checked
checked.description: Controlled mode: explicitly control whether the checkbox is checked.

indeterminate.name: indeterminate
indeterminate.description: Visually marks the checkbox as partially selected.

error.name: error
error.description: Renders the checkbox with the error color role.

name.name: name
name.description: Name of the underlying form control.

value.name: value
value.description: Value submitted with the form when checked.

onChange.name: onChange
onChange.description: Native change handler of the underlying input element.
